searchText: Another potential performance gain on high blob count - add SSZ support to `getBlobsV2` and `getPayloadV5`. Serialising & parsing ~16mb (64 blobs) of JSON during block production / proposal may take a bit of time, i dont have numbers tho and is different in different languages. Would like to hear thoughts if it's worth doing in Fusaka? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/630/files#r2017920764 <@519796549279023105> <@277500722655002624> <@543900561460822016> <@656728086410297356> Another potential performance gain on beacon-api getBlobsSidecar change in fulu are we good with both of these? https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/489 and https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/516, seems complete to me but looking for approvals before merging (also wanna check if we missed some electra stuff but it seems we are good) https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/peerdas-devnet-6 Just a heads up, this has been updated ^ this should now track open PRs. There's a ton of discussions going on, so if you notice something stale - please help update it! see something, say something See it, Say it, Sorted! If the `getBlobSidecars` changes go into a separate PR, I believe both are ready. Another heads up, we'll be making a `v1.5.0-beta.4` release mid next week with the PRs listed here. After that's made, I'll update the peerdas-devnet-6 specs to use that. I think those should be separate PRs, for now just the required changes should be made imo
